notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
description:
Cast Somberwald Beastmaster by paying {G}.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Wolf and two Beasts, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Somberwald Beastmaster from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
